title: metrics/<site_id>_<period_id>.json: summary numbers for one site over one period
description: Every metric is {value, uncertainty}. Windows give exact start/end times so the FE can show 'sunset in 41 h' without computing anything.

sun_threshold_frac.description: sun_visible_frac above which a step counts as 'sunlit' (e.g. 0.5)

hours_to_first_dark_h.description: OPTIONAL: hours from the window start to sunset (0 = dark at the start; value null = never dark)

hours_to_first_sun_h.description: OPTIONAL: hours from the window start to sunrise (0 = already sunlit; value null = never sunlit)

hours_to_first_earth_loss_h.description: OPTIONAL: hours from the window start to Earthset (0 = no Earth at the start; null = never lost)

hours_to_first_earth_h.description: OPTIONAL: hours from the window start to Earthrise (0 = Earth already visible; null = never visible)

dsn_available_frac.description: LATER: Earth visible AND a DSN station sees the Moon

battery_needed_wh.description: LATER: energy to survive longest_dark_h; load assumption in source.notes

earth_min_elev_deg.description: OPTIONAL: antenna mask; a step is Earth-visible only if earth_el_deg >= this AND earth_visible_frac >= 0.5

mast_curve.description: LATER: sunlit fraction vs mast height
